description: "A Treatise of Cleanness in Meats and Drinks, of the Preparation of Food, by Tryon" is a health and wellness treatise written in the late 17th century. This book discusses the importance of cleanliness in food preparation and consumption, as well as the quality of air and bedding for proper health.
